rawScenePlan.title: 1 — Bureaucracy of the Atrium
rawScenePlan.event: The Kaufhaus central atrium reconfigures itself: low display islands click and fold into a tight grid of service cubicles; metal turnstiles silently rise from the tiled floor around the central well and a refrigerated butcher cubicle seals into place, its lights lowering to a clinical glow.
rawScenePlan.consequence: A row of closed metal turnstiles and a sealed refrigerated butcher cubicle stand in the atrium.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: The sealed butcher cubicle begins to pulse and leak along its lower seam.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Wide interior of the Kaufhaus atrium reconfigured into a grid of small service cubicles and raised metal turnstiles; the refrigerated butcher cubicle in one cell glows dimly, no people, no monster visible, no readable text or logos.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Tracking shot through the Kaufhaus atrium as display islands mechanically fold into compact cubicles; metal turnstiles eject from the floor with precise clicks; the camera settles on a refrigerated butcher cubicle whose lower seam trembles as a faint wetness forms at the edge, filmed as practical, in-camera effects.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: Start wide, steady cam dolly forward, then push to a mid shot of the butcher cubicle seam where wetness forms.

rawScenePlan.title: 2 — Flesh as Procedure
rawScenePlan.event: In the sealed butcher cubicle, cured slabs and trays of cold cuts take on slow, flesh-like micro-movements: one slab contracts and exhales a bead of glossy crimson that rolls off the tray and joins a slick trail across the tiles.
rawScenePlan.consequence: A glossy red trail runs out of the cubicle and across the main tiled walkway toward the escalator.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: Safety systems begin to engage around the crimson trail.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Close-up of refrigerated trays in the butcher cubicle: cured slabs pulse subtly and a bead of glossy red fluid rolls off a tray onto tiles, no people, no monster visible.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Macro dolly along the butcher tray as one slab pulses and releases a bead of crimson that rolls down the metal lip, follows the bead as it joins a widening red trail across the floor; practical effects emphasize texture and weight.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: Extreme close-up on the rolling bead, quick whip-pan following it as it moves out of frame toward the walkway.

rawScenePlan.title: 3 — Automatic Containment
rawScenePlan.event: Floor channels click open and extrude thin yellow polymer ribbons that climb and wrap themselves around the red trail; micro-sprinklers deploy a neutralizing foam that beads and smothers portions of the slick, forming semi-transparent foam pockets over the stain.
rawScenePlan.consequence: Yellow polymer ribbons and foam-sealed pockets encase parts of the red trail; glossy gaps remain between sealed sections.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: The safety choreography draws people to form a human perimeter around the sealed pockets.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Low-angle view of tiled floor where thin yellow polymer ribbons have risen and coil around a red trail; pockets of white neutralizing foam bead over portions of the slick, no people, no monster visible.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Low camera track as polymer ribbons extrude from floor channels and climb around the red trail while sprinklers hiss soft foam that beads and seals sections of the stain; focus on the mechanical extrusion and bead texture.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: Keep camera low and track alongside a rising ribbon as it wraps the trail, revealing foam pockets filling the gaps.

rawScenePlan.title: 4 — The Public Forms
rawScenePlan.event: Under pulsing amber safety lights, shoppers and staff converge and, almost choreographically, lift packages and step into a tight ring around the foam-sealed pockets; their motions are synchronized — small practiced steps, hands rising together — creating a living barricade that blocks the escalator.
rawScenePlan.consequence: A human ring of people holding products blocks access to the escalator; footprints in the foam lead inward toward the sealed trail.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: A sudden burst — blackout and concussive pop — will rupture the ring and expose a displaced display and a fallen ceiling tile.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Medium shot of shoppers and staff aligned in a tight ring around foam-sealed pockets, each holding packages aloft, faces intent, no monster visible.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Overhead crane shot descends as people step into formation in sync, hands raising boxes and packages above heads to form a human barricade; capture the choreography and the blocked escalator.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: Crane descends from above, then pushes forward toward the blocked escalator, ending on a close frame of a footprint in the foam.

rawScenePlan.title: 5 — Rupture: The Creature Unhooks
rawScenePlan.event: Lights snap out and a mechanical pop reverberates; shoppers scatter and packages tumble. Amid the chaos a weathered practical creature-sculpture — stitched leather hide, oxidized metal ribs, glassy pitted eyes — unhooks from a display pedestal. It drags a fallen ceiling tile as it lurches across the floor, brushing a torn shopping bag and leaving a smeared, dried residue on tiles as it passes.
rawScenePlan.consequence: A torn shopping bag stained with dried hybrid residue lies under a fallen ceiling tile in the cleared aisle.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: That stained bag will trigger automated displays and a compulsive movement of goods toward the exits.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Interior chaos in the Kaufhaus after a blackout: shoppers scatter, packages tumble; a weathered practical creature-sculpture (stitched leather, oxidized metal, glass eyes) physically moves across the floor, drags a fallen ceiling tile and smears dried residue on the tiles; filmed in-camera with tactile props.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Handheld follows the practical creature-sculpture as it unhooks from a pedestal and lurches through the chaotic aisle, practical seams creaking, joints articulated; it brushes a torn shopping bag and leaves smeared residue, ceiling tile sliding behind — no CGI, purely physical effects.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: Handheld follows behind the creature as it moves, then cut to low close-up on its hand smearing residue onto a torn bag.

rawScenePlan.title: 6 — Commerce Flows
rawScenePlan.event: At contact with the stained bag the display motors reawaken: stacked goods and unattended shopping carts begin to slide in an ordered flood down the aisles toward the exits. Shoppers, drawn like bees, compulsively snatch and consume items. The weathered creature perches atop a rolling cart and guides the current, balancing as the flow pushes it toward the doors.
rawScenePlan.consequence: A streaming river of packaged goods flows toward the exit; the creature rides a cart out, leaving a scuffed skid mark and a small heap of emptied packaging piled like readable change (no text).
rawScenePlan.nextHook: The flow continues toward the exit, the conflict unresolved as the Kaufhaus empties into the street.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Long interior view down an aisle transformed into a moving flood of packaged goods and rolling carts; shoppers reach in a compulsive rhythm; the weathered practical creature-sculpture perches on a cart steering the flow, practical prop emphasized.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Dolly track alongside the moving current of goods and carts as they stream down the aisle toward the exit; cut to low stabilized shot of the creature balanced on a cart, the camera tilts down to a scuffed skid mark and a small pile of emptied packaging at the floor.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: Dolly in sync with the moving flow, then tilt down to capture the skid mark as the creature and cart pass out of frame.
